frames.body:
CONCORD OFFICE · FILING

FROSTLINE

Outpost Vesna — The Works

A mountain synthesis plant, one floor, one operative. The vats cook the Combine's solvent. The reel is the month's cipher. The cameras watch the bays. Walk out through the cargo dock, or don't come back.

THE WORKS
Outpost Vesna — The Works
THE SPUR
The Spur — Cable House
COURIER
Extract
Reach the extraction. Everything else on the list is someone else's paper.
FIELD
Sabotage
Finish this filing's sabotage list and walk out. A dead technician fails it.
WRAITH
Unseen
Field's list, and darken the cameras before they mark you. An alarm ends the clearance.
ENTER THE WORKS
COUCH

Stick to walk, right stick to look. R2 fires, L2 aims, Square reloads, Triangle uses, Circle crouches, R1 cycles. Options opens the watch.

DESK

WASD walks, mouse looks. Click fires, right mouse aims, R reloads, E uses, C crouches, Shift sprints. Esc opens the watch.

POCKET

Left thumb walks, right half of the glass looks. Fire, Aim, Use, Jump, Next, Low sit in the corner. The mark opens the watch.

Fullscreen
Source note

Operative Ivo Marin · Sever Combine
